reason: Pixel information property (ISO/IEC 23008-12): the bit depth of each channel of an item, a few bytes, nothing beyond what the coded image states. The heic walker has no parser for it.
APP5 asset-manager record in Met Museum JPEGs: the museum's own digital-asset id, kept with the rest of the museum's published metadata (EXPORT-PLAN: keep the museum metadata).

ISO 21496-1 gain-map metadata (APP2) of the 33 UltraHDR JPEGs: a version record in the primary image and the gain-map parameters in the gain-map image. HDR structure the originals keep (whitelist v2); zenjpeg's UltraHDR reader parses both, the 2026-10-10 inventory walker has no parser for them.
